cases.query: How does an optional concept search turn ranked graph matches into bounded structural entry points without building new state?

required_seeds.name: RankedSemanticSeeds
required_seeds.reason: This is the Grimoire-side boundary that checks for an existing Arcana vector index, invokes semantic-query, deduplicates matches, and preserves score and rank metadata for hybrid selection.

supporting_seeds.name: semanticIndexExists
supporting_seeds.reason: This helper enforces the no-build, existing-index-only contract.

required_structural.reason: Final graph evidence must retain the ranked semantic seed provider's operational neighborhood.

cases.notes: The query deliberately avoids the exact CLI phrase semantic-query to test conceptual graph entry-point retrieval.

cases.query: Where are vocabulary-derived symbols and conceptual graph matches balanced before deterministic relationship expansion?

required_seeds.name: collectStructuralContext
required_seeds.reason: This function owns the complete provider composition path.

required_seeds.name: RerankSeeds
required_seeds.reason: This boundary fuses Lexicon rank, vector similarity, declaration quality, query terms, and bounded graph-neighborhood evidence before the production six-seed cutoff.

required_structural.reason: Final evidence must connect provider collection to hybrid seed selection.

cases.notes: This is the primary paired case for whether semantic seeds add useful entry points beyond Lexicon vocabulary.

cases.query: Which boundary resolves a few graph anchors and then asks for roles, dependents, uncertain references, and short execution paths?

required_seeds.name: Search
required_seeds.reason: Client.Search resolves bounded seeds and requests all deterministic Arcana evidence shapes.

supporting_seeds.name: resolveSeeds
supporting_seeds.reason: Seed resolution chooses exact-path matches before broad symbol matches.

required_structural.reason: Final evidence must retain the deterministic graph expansion owner.

cases.notes: Uses conceptual synonyms for impact, unresolved references, and call chains.

cases.query: Where is each repository graph entity rendered with bounded inbound, outbound, and unresolved neighborhood text for embeddings?

required_seeds.name: graph_documents
required_seeds.reason: This function builds one deterministic semantic document per graph node.

required_seeds.name: render_document
required_seeds.reason: This function renders node identity, bounded relationships, and unresolved references.

required_structural.reason: Final evidence must retain the graph-document construction owner.

cases.notes: Measures whether semantic entry points recover the Rust implementation behind conceptual graph-document language.

cases.query: How is a conceptual task embedded, checked against immutable graph identity, scored over packed node vectors, and returned in stable order?

required_seeds.name: search_index
required_seeds.reason: This private mechanism validates the selected immutable index, embeds the query, scores every node vector, and deterministically ranks hits; search_current_index is only its public current-snapshot wrapper.

supporting_seeds.name: manifest_matches
supporting_seeds.reason: This helper binds semantic results to graph and model identity.

required_structural.reason: Final evidence must retain the semantic graph search implementation owner rather than its thin wrapper.

cases.notes: Covers the Arcana-owned vector search rather than Grimoire documentation vectors.
